dct_description_sm: Our study took place in under-ice seawater of Young Sound-Tyrolerfjord in Northeast Greenland between 1 and 30 June 2014. The partial pressure of CO2 (pCO2) using a CONTROS HydroC® CO2 and seawater temperature and salinity using a SBE37SM were measured continuously at high frequency of 0.2 Hz at roughly 2.5 m below the sea ice.
dct_subject_sm: Conductivity and temperature recorder, Sea-Bird, SBE37-SM RS-232
dct_title_s: Continuous measurements of pCO2 in under-ice seawater during the onset of sea ice melt in Young Sound, Northeast Greenland, in 2014
